title: Seedance is making a fresh push into education with study app Gauth — starting with AI animated lessons
excerpt: The app is partnering with the edtech app Gauth to create videos that explain concepts in stories. Both Gauth and Seedance are owned by ByteDance.
content_html:
Exclusive

By Aditi Bharade

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

ByteDance's viral AI video app is seeking a new, younger audience through a collaboration with the education app Gauth.

Gauth, an AI-powered edtech app, told Business Insider its new update will feature AI-generated videos from Seedance to help translate concepts into stories for students. This will go live on August 4, lining up with back-to-school season.

"Created in collaboration with Seedance, it transforms subjects into cinematic, AI-narrated visual stories that make abstract concepts finally click, with adaptive quizzes woven throughout to turn passive watching into active recall," Gauth said in its press release.

Seedance and Gauth are both owned by ByteDance, the Chinese parent of TikTok.

Gauth, which launched in 2020, now has 86 million monthly active users, a 760% increase since 2023, the company told Business Insider.

The first courses on Gauth to be given Seedance's cinematic treatment will be history-related, with other subjects to follow, the company said. Business Insider saw video previews in Gauth's app covering topics such as World War 2, the Industrial Revolution, and the Meiji Restoration.

Gauth's CTO Alan Wang said in the press release that the new phase of the app, called "AI Course," will make learning feel "less like studying and more like being pulled into a story."

Seedance, a platform for AI-generated videos, launched version 2.5 on Friday, promising smarter editing capabilities and longer videos up to 30 seconds per generation. Gauth will use version 2.5 in its "AI Course."

Seedance, similar in function to Meta's short-lived Sora, has boosted China's booming AI drama industry. The app went viral earlier this year after it drew scrutiny from production houses and streaming services, including Disney and Netflix, over intellectual property concerns.

In a statement shared with Business Insider in February, ByteDance said it would "strengthen safeguards" on the app and that it "respects intellectual property rights."

作者：Aditi Bharade 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

字节跳动的病毒式人工智能视频应用程序正在通过与教育应用程序 Gauth 的合作来寻找新的年轻受众。

Gauth 是一款人工智能驱动的教育科技应用程序，它告诉《商业内幕》，其新更新将包含 Seedance 的人工智能生成视频，帮助学生将概念转化为故事。 该功能将于 8 月 4 日上线，与返校季同步。

Gauth 在其新闻稿中表示：“它是与 Seedance 合作创建的，将主题转变为由人工智能讲述的电影视觉故事，使抽象概念最终产生共鸣，并贯穿始终的自适应测验将被动观看转变为主动回忆。”

Seedance 和 Gauth 均属于 TikTok 的中国母公司字节跳动公司。

该公司告诉 Business Insider，Gauth 于 2020 年推出，目前每月活跃用户数为 8600 万，自 2023 年以来增长了 760%。

该公司表示，第一个采用 Seedance 电影化处理的 Gauth 课程将与历史相关，随后还会推出其他课程。 《商业内幕》在 Gauth 的应用程序中看到了涵盖第二次世界大战、工业革命和明治维新等主题的视频预览。

Gauth 的首席技术官 Alan Wang 在新闻稿中表示，该应用程序的新阶段称为“AI 课程”，将使学习感觉“不再像学习，而更像是被拉入故事中”。

人工智能生成视频平台 Seedance 于周五推出了 2.5 版本，承诺提供更智能的编辑功能以及每代长达 30 秒的更长视频。 Gauth 将在其“AI 课程”中使用 2.5 版本。

Seedance的功能类似于Meta的短命Sora，推动了中国蓬勃发展的AI戏剧产业。 今年早些时候，该应用程序因知识产权问题而受到迪士尼和 Netflix 等制作公司和流媒体服务公司的审查，随后迅速走红。

在二月份与《商业内幕》分享的一份声明中，字节跳动表示将“加强对该应用程序的保障”，并“尊重知识产权”。
